label: D1 after a2 reached S2 rewarded, strongest when the trial before was rare (a2 to S1 unrewarded).
short_terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * (tv("common", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * (tv("reward", -2) == -9)
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) * (tv("action", -2) == 2) * (tv("state", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) * (tv("action", -2) == 2) * (tv("state", -2) == 1) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) * (tv("action", -2) == 2) * (tv("state", -2) == 1) * (tv("reward", -3) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) * (tv("action", -2) == 2) * (tv("state", -2) == 1) * (tv("action", -3) == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * (tv("reward", -2) == -9) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) * (tv("action", -2) == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * (tv("reward", -2) == -9) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == -1) * (in_rew == 1)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (zero at GO/D2). It needs the previous trial to be a2 -> S2 rewarded; after any other last trial it is silent. Within that, the size depends on the trial before: large (~0.6-0.7) when it was a2 -> S1 rare and unrewarded (a model-based stay on a2 that then paid off in S2), close to zero when the trial before was rewarded or common, and moderate when the trial before lies outside the window (unknown). Short form: rare transition two back, unrewarded two back, unknown two back, each gated by D1 and last=a2 S2 r. Because of the 3-factor limit it cannot express the exact conjunction a2 & S1 & unrewarded two back. The free fit uses that exact conjunction, scales it by belief_lo (more negative, i.e. more sure S2 is good, gives more), and adds small 3-back terms. Remaining misses are mostly on window-first D1 steps whose history is not in the window. No future variables are used.
